content: The Crypto Stack shall support isolating keys and requests Status: DRAFT Description: In a multi-tenant scenario the Crypto Stack shall implement an individual logical view of available session keys and active operations for each tenant. Rationale: A application using the Crypto Stack should not be able to observe or manipulate the list of active keys and crypto operations of another application (error injection, timing side-channels, etc.).
